security: LE Secure Connections, bonded, encrypted and authenticated

characteristics.name: counties
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, u8 count (0-16), count x 6 ASCII digits PSSCCC

characteristics.name: travel_counties
characteristics.layout: same layout as counties; used only in travel mode

characteristics.name: mode
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, u8 mode (0 home, 1 travel), u8 channel (0 auto-scan, 1-7)

characteristics.name: event_filter
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, u8 preset (0 warnings, 1 warnings+watches, 2 all, 3 custom), 16-byte bitmap over event table indices

characteristics.name: event_table
characteristics.layout: indexed. write u8 schema, u8 op: 0 select (u8 index), 1 begin (u16 version, u8 count), 2 entry (u8 index, 3 ASCII code, u8 class, u8 name_len, name), 3 commit, 4 abort. read: u8 schema, u16 version, u8 count, u8 index, 3 ASCII code, u8 class, u8 name_len, name

characteristics.name: time
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, i64 UTC seconds, u8 tz_len (1-48), POSIX TZ string

characteristics.name: presets
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, u8 count (0-8), count x (u8 band 0 FM 1 AM 2 WB, u32 kHz)

characteristics.name: status
characteristics.layout: u8 schema, u8 battery %, u16 hours left, i8 SNR dB, i8 RSSI dBuV, u8 channel, i64 last weekly test UTC (-1 none), u32 health flags, u8 lock

characteristics.name: alert_log
characteristics.layout: indexed. write u8 schema, u8 index (0 newest). read/notify: u8 schema, u8 count, u8 index, i64 received UTC (-1 unset), u8 outcome, u8 flags, u8 len, raw header

characteristics.name: control
characteristics.layout: write u8 schema, u8 command (1 test alert, 2 clear log, 3 factory reset). indicate: u8 schema, u8 command, u8 result (0 done, 1 awaiting confirmation, 2 cancelled, 3 rejected)

errors.name: VALUE
errors.meaning: a field out of range or malformed; nothing changed

errors.name: STORAGE
errors.meaning: applied, but saving to flash failed; lost at the next restart

errors.name: SEQUENCE
errors.meaning: event table entry or commit out of order

errors.name: BUSY
errors.meaning: a command is waiting for confirmation on the radio

errors.name: INDEX
errors.meaning: selected index is past the end of the list
